books.title: Piranesi
books.author: Susanna Clarke
books.synopsis: Piranesi lives in the House. Perhaps he always has. In his notebooks he day by day records its wonders: the labyrinth of halls, the thousands of statues, the tides that rush up staircases.
books.matchReason: A breathtakingly atmospheric literary mystery with profound philosophical depth.
books.destinyText: "The Beauty of the House is immeasurable; its Kindness infinite. A sacred labyrinth that mirrors your quest for truth."

capsule.quote: "The Beauty of the House is immeasurable; its Kindness infinite."

characters.name: Piranesi
characters.role: The Protagonist — innocent, observant scholar of the House

characters.name: The Other
characters.role: The Rival — ambitious, arrogant seeker of worldly power

capsule.discussion: How does Piranesi’s unconditional gratitude contrast with our modern obsession with conquering our environment?

books.title: Project Hail Mary
books.author: Andy Weir
books.synopsis: Ryland Grace is the sole survivor on a desperate, last-chance mission—and if he fails, humanity and the earth itself will perish.
books.matchReason: Unstoppable scientific optimism, high-stakes space survival, and one of modern fiction’s greatest friendships.
books.destinyText: "Alone in the void of space, you discover that interstellar survival hinges on the courage of cross-species connection."

capsule.quote: "I am terrifying space monster. You are leaky space blob."

characters.name: Ryland Grace
characters.role: Reluctant middle-school teacher turned humanity’s last astronaut

capsule.discussion: Why is optimism and curiosity often more potent than fear when facing existential extinction?

books.title: The Silent Patient
books.author: Alex Michaelides
books.synopsis: Alicia Berenson’s life is seemingly perfect. One evening she shoots her husband five times in the face, and then never speaks another word.
books.matchReason: Gripping psychological labyrinth filled with Greek tragedy motifs and an earth-shattering twist.
books.destinyText: "Silence is a scream wrapped in memory. Unravel the locked truth before the mind consumes itself."

capsule.quote: "One of the hardest things to admit is that we weren’t loved when we needed it most."

characters.name: Alicia Berenson
characters.role: Celebrated painter who murdered her husband in cold blood

characters.name: Theo Faber
characters.role: Psychotherapist obsessed with uncovering her motive

capsule.discussion: How does childhood neglect warp adult perception, and who was truly the patient in the room?

books.title: The House in the Cerulean Sea
books.author: TJ Klune
books.synopsis: Linus Baker is a by-the-book caseworker at the Department in Charge of Magical Youth. He’s tasked with a highly classified assignment on a secluded island orphanage.
books.matchReason: A heartwarming, uplifting embrace of found family and standing up for the misunderstood.
books.destinyText: "A warm blanket for the heart. An island where eccentric magical children teach a bureaucrat how to feel alive."

capsule.quote: "Change often starts with the smallest of whispers. Like-minded people standing up together."

characters.name: Linus Baker
characters.role: Rigid caseworker whose heart expands tenfold

characters.name: Arthur Parnassus
characters.role: Fiercely protective master of the orphanage

capsule.discussion: How does systemic prejudice masquerade as "polite policy" in our daily institutions?

books.title: Tomorrow, and Tomorrow, and Tomorrow
books.author: Gabrielle Zevin
books.synopsis: On a bitter-cold day, Sam Masur exits a subway car and sees Sadie Green. Thus begins a legendary collaboration in video game design that will catapult them to stardom.
books.matchReason: A profound exploration of creative partnership, lifelong friendship, and grief across thirty years.
books.destinyText: "To play a game is to believe in second chances. An ode to creativity, collaboration, and enduring love."

capsule.quote: "There is a time for any fledgling artist when one’s taste exceeds one’s abilities."

characters.name: Sam Masur
characters.role: Brilliant game architect burdened by physical pain

characters.name: Sadie Green
characters.role: Visionary coder wrestling with depression and sexism

capsule.discussion: Why is platonic creative partnership often more emotionally intense than romantic love?

books.title: Fourth Wing
books.author: Rebecca Yarros
books.synopsis: Twenty-year-old Violet Sorrengail was supposed to enter the quiet Scribe Quadrant. Instead, the commanding general orders her to join the deadly dragon riders.
books.matchReason: Relentless pacing, fierce dragons, deadly academy trials, and undeniable romantic tension.
books.destinyText: "A dragon without its rider is a tragedy. A rider without their dragon is dead. Climb or perish."

capsule.quote: "I will not die today. Hope is a fickle, dangerous thing."

characters.name: Violet Sorrengail
characters.role: Clever, frail cadet defying the brutal death odds

characters.name: Xaden Riorson
characters.role: Lethal wing leader harboring rebel secrets

capsule.discussion: How does physical vulnerability force characters to rely on mental agility and strategic alliances?

books.title: Yellowface
books.author: R.F. Kuang
books.synopsis: When darling author Athena Liu dies in a freak accident, jealous friend June Hayward steals her unfinished manuscript about Chinese laborers in WWI and publishes it as her own.
books.matchReason: A razor-sharp, satirical, and uncomfortably addictive look at publishing, cultural appropriation, and internet outrage.
books.destinyText: "Envy is a poison that tastes like ambition. How far will you run with a stolen ghost?"

capsule.quote: "Writing is a fundamentally isolated, lonely thing. Theft makes it a spectator sport."

characters.name: Athena Liu
characters.role: Dazzling literary prodigy whose shadow looms large

capsule.discussion: At what point does "artistic freedom" cross into predatory cultural exploitation?

books.title: Atomic Habits
books.author: James Clear
books.synopsis: A comprehensive, practical guide on how to change your habits and get 1% better every day through tiny, compounding actions.
books.matchReason: Transformative non-fiction that demystifies personal behavior and habit loops.
books.destinyText: "You do not rise to the level of your goals. You fall to the level of your systems."

capsule.quote: "You do not rise to the level of your goals. You fall to the level of your systems."
capsule.discussion: Why is focusing on who you want to become far more durable than focusing on what you want to achieve?
